title: 2024 Bowman Chrome Baseball Anthony Baptist 1st BCP-141 New York NY Mets
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
This 2024 Bowman Chrome baseball card features Anthony Baptist from the New York Mets. The card is part of the base set and has a card number of BCP-141. It is a sports trading card manufactured by Topps and is part of the Major League (MLB) league. The card is a Chrome parallel/variety and has no autograph.

The card is perfect for collectors who are fans of the New York Mets or baseball in general. It is a great addition to any sports trading card collection and is sure to impress. Don't miss out on the opportunity to add this card to your collection!
